name: Surrounding Voxel Neighbor Traversal
definition: A generic visitor pattern implementation that iterates over the 6 immediate spatial neighbors (West, East, Bottom, Top, North, South) of a voxel at a given flat index within a VoxelGrid. It handles boundary conditions by crossing into adjacent VoxelGrids if they exist.
summary: Surrounding Voxel Neighbor Traversal iterates over a voxel's six spatial neighbors, uniquely handling multi-grid boundaries by redirecting traversal to adjacent grids when neighbors fall outside the current grid's dimensions.
